title: Storyline Day 6: Oracle Data Safe & Autonomous Database Sensitive SQL Extraction
description: Detects Day 6 of the 7-day multi-pillar adversary storyline: unauthorized SQL schema enumeration (all_tab_columns) and bulk sensitive PII extraction (CRM_CORE.CUSTOMER_PII) against Autonomous Databases guardian-standalone-adb and oci4cca-observeai-adb.
query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('DB Target' in ('guardian-standalone-adb', 'oci4cca-observeai-adb') or 'DB Statement' like '*CUSTOMER_PII*' or 'DB Statement' like '*all_tab_columns*') | stats count as db_audit_hits, distinctcount('DB Target') as targeted_databases by 'DB Target', User, 'Attack Stage' | sort -db_audit_hits
falsepositives: Scheduled DBA schema migration or Oracle Data Safe sensitive data discovery job
investigation_notes: Verify DB Statement and Attack Stage on guardian-standalone-adb and oci4cca-observeai-adb.
Check Oracle Data Safe finding ORA-DS-PRIV-004 and confirm Data Safe masking policy enforcement.
